routes.label: SEIS Hub
routes.intent: Create the God Mode architecture roadmap scope ecosystem coordination plan.
routes.signal: Architecture, roadmap, ecosystem coordination, and God Mode scope.
routes.handoff: Frame the mission, risk boundary, validation evidence, and rollback path.

routes.label: Governance
routes.intent: Prepare release quality license governance policy handoff evidence.
routes.signal: Release readiness, quality gates, license posture, and handoff evidence.
routes.handoff: Attach governance proof before commit, push, or completion claims.

routes.label: Cloud
routes.intent: Check cloud deployment provider ssh vpn rollback cost readiness.
routes.signal: Cloud, SSH, VPN, deployment, rollback, cost, and provider readiness.
routes.handoff: Keep local, GitHub, and SEIS Cloud boundaries explicit before access changes.

routes.label: Code
routes.intent: Use codex primary execution for code MCP tool runtime bug tests package patch.
routes.signal: Code changes, MCP tools, runtime fixes, tests, and package scripts.
routes.handoff: Implement the smallest durable slice and leave validation hooks visible.

routes.label: Design
routes.intent: Open design visual prototype for UI UX accessibility responsive motion layout.
routes.signal: UI hierarchy, accessibility, motion, responsive behavior, and design tokens.
routes.handoff: Preserve calm density while making the operational state easier to scan.

routes.label: Data
routes.intent: Transform dataset memory schema provenance training report RAG quality evidence.
routes.signal: Datasets, memory, provenance, schemas, training evidence, and quality signals.
routes.handoff: Keep synthetic data, source policy, and redaction boundaries attached.

routes.label: Security
routes.intent: Audit secret token credential redaction vulnerability permission hardening exposure security risk.
routes.signal: Secrets, private keys, vulnerabilities, hardening, permissions, and risk.
routes.handoff: Apply the safety floor before any lower-risk lane can execute.

routes.label: Research
routes.intent: Browser research official documentation standards version compatibility source quality.
routes.signal: Official docs, standards, compatibility, source quality, and evidence checks.
routes.handoff: Convert external assumptions into cited evidence before architecture decisions.

routes.label: Automation
routes.intent: Prepare idempotent dry-run automation workflow scheduled runbook generator repeatable failure-handling validation output.
routes.signal: Idempotent workflows, schedules, runbooks, dry-runs, and rollback steps.
routes.handoff: Make every automated action explainable, reversible, and evidence-producing.

routes.label: Product
routes.intent: Define product requirements acceptance launch outcome milestone roadmap-slice user-jobs non-goals.
routes.signal: Requirements, acceptance criteria, launch readiness, user outcomes, and non-goals.
routes.handoff: Translate strategy into one shippable roadmap slice with explicit boundaries.
